i bought Aerosmiths 1st record in a place in Clearwater, FL. inside had "This album belongs to ... "
I looked her up on Facebook and she had passed away about 5 years prior. i did send a quick message to her son, who was like 45. He confirmed it was his moms record. She had to sell her record collection years prior to get money to move to Florida.  he lived in Maryland.
I sent him his moms album. Figured it was the least I could do.
comments.author: @jabberdouche
